headline: Builders FirstSource (BLDR) Is Doubling Down On Acquisitions In Key Markets
summary: Builders FirstSource (NYSE:BLDR) highlighted an ongoing focus on acquisitions to grow its value added product offerings. The company reiterated this priority during its latest quarterly earnings call, with both the CEO and CFO underscoring acquisition activity as a key lever. The approach targets stronger positions in selected regional markets within the highly fragmented building products industry.
